_readme: Sharing a story to WhatsApp status (Avraham, 2026-10-19). For each story listed here, its 'share' button (on the site's card and on the story page s/<slug>/) asks: as a message (as before) or to status. 'hook' is printed on the status picture (assets/images/status/<slug>.jpg, made by tools/build_status_images.py), 'caption' is the text that goes with it ({url} = the story's listening page). 'popup': true = when the story ends on its page, a popup invites the listener to share it to status. After a change: python tools/build_status_images.py, then node tools/build_story_pages.mjs.
